q41.question: Under the Trade Credit Insurance policy, a Counterparty becomes insolvent. Within what period must the Insured submit a complete claim, and from which date does that period run?
q41.ground_truth: Within 60 days after the Date of Loss. For a loss due to Insolvency, the Date of Loss is the Due Date, which is the payment date originally set by the Contract.

q42.ground_truth: INR 200 million. One quarter of the payments record is INR 250 million, but the Preliminary limit cannot exceed INR 200 million. It may be applied for 3 months from the date it was set up, unless the Insurer restricts it.

- greater than or equal to 40, or

  i. Obesity-related cardiomyopathy
  ii. Coronary heart disease
  iii. Severe Sleep Apnea
  iv. Uncontrolled Type2 Diabetes

The conditions for the surgical treatment of obesity are:
1. Surgery to be conducted is upon the advice of the Doctor
2. The surgery/Procedure conducted should be supported by clinical protocols
3. The member has to be 18 years of age or older

At each policy anniversary, starting from the first policy anniversary, CI SA will increase every year and Life Cover SA will decrease by the same amount. This amount is calculated as: 30% × Basic Sum Assured ÷ Policy Term. For a Basic Sum Assured of Rs 1 crore and a Policy Term of 20 years, that amount is 30% × 1 crore ÷ 20 = Rs 1.5 lakh per year.

The suicide exclusion also runs for 12 months from the date of revival, so the nominee gets at least 80% of the total premiums paid till death or the surrender value on the date of death, whichever is higher, provided the policy is in force.

Under the Weather Insurance (Retail) policy:

- **Data if the reference weather station has no data:** If weather data is not available from the reference data source/weather station, then the **back-up data source/weather stations data** will be used. If weather data from the back-up data source/weather stations is also not available, then the weather data generated through the **fallback methodology** will be used.

- For Trip Curtailment claims, required documents include "Airline correspondence (copy of passenger list etc.), with details of hijack incident."
- For Hijack/Kidnap Daily Allowance claims, required documents include: "1. Full statement of the events in writing; 2. Airline correspondence (copy of passenger list etc.), with details of hijack incident; and 3. Copy of FIR in case of kidnapping."

Under the Aviation Insurance policy, hijacking is addressed in the "WAR, HI-JACKING AND OTHER PERILS EXCLUSION CLAUSE (AVIATION)":

- "This Insurance does not apply to claims caused by: ... - "Furthermore, this Insurance does not cover claims arising whilst an aircraft is outside the control of the Insured by reason of any of the above perils. q85.ground_truth: 75% in all three. Cyber Shield and Specie Insurance retain 75% of the annual rate for a period not exceeding 6 months. Weather Insurance refunds 25% of the full premium for more than 3 and up to 6 months, so it keeps 75%.

q86.question: What happens to the insurance when the insured property is sold or changes owner under the Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy, the SBI General Livestock policy, and the Bharat Griha Raksha policy?
q86.ground_truth: Auto Secure: the Liability Only cover is deemed transferred to the new owner from the date of transfer, and the transferee must apply within 14 days. SBI General Livestock: the policy stands cancelled and no payment is made if ownership of the animal passes to another person, except by operation of law. Bharat Griha Raksha: the policy ends when the insured sells or releases the interest in the home building or contents.

Under the **Bharat Griha Raksha Policy**, the Policy will end when you sell, surrender or release your interest in your Home Building and/or Home Contents, or your interest in the Home Building and/or Home Contents comes to an end. Under the **Auto Secure Commercial Vehicle Package Policy**, on transfer of ownership the Liability Only cover shall be deemed to be transferred in favour of the person to whom the motor vehicle is transferred with effect from the date of transfer. The transferee shall apply within fourteen days from the date of transfer.

q87.question: Is a loss that is discovered only during an inventory covered under the Specie Insurance policy, the Contractors Plant and Machinery Insurance policy, and the Political Risk Insurance for Investors policy?
q87.ground_truth: No, in all three. Specie Insurance excludes loss or shortage discovered while taking inventory. Contractors Plant and Machinery excludes loss or damage discovered only at the time of taking an inventory or during routine servicing. Political Risk excludes shortage discovered on taking inventory.

q104.question: Under the Trade Credit Insurance policy, a buyer does not pay an invoice. A director of that buyer is a first cousin of a director of my company. Is the loss covered?
q104.ground_truth: No, unless the Insurer has agreed otherwise in writing. A blood relationship between directors of the Insured and the Counterparty, up to direct cousins, is a Controlling influence. q111.answer:
If the weather data is not available from the reference data source/weather station, then the back-up data source/weather stations data will be used. If weather data from back-up data source/weather stations are also not available, then the weather data generated through fallback methodology will be used.

Under the fallback methodology, if the Data Provider does not publish the Daily observed weather data for any calendar day during the Policy Period, the missing data shall be replaced with an average value calculated as follows: any missing data shall be replaced with data measured on the corresponding dates of the most recent available mutually agreed number of historical years on an iterative basis. If more than one data point is missing for the current year, all the replacement data shall be taken from the same historical year(s), so that if in any historical year data is available for one date corresponding to a missing data point in the current year, but is not available for another missing data point, that historical year's data shall not be used as replacement data. Each of the last mutually agreed number of historical year's available replacement data shall be applied in turn in place of each of the missing data points, and the loss payable under the Policy shall equate to the average of the mutually agreed number of [historical years].

q114.answer:
The insurer scales down a damage payout under the Average clause. According to the context, if the market value of an item of equipment at the time of an accident is greater than the insured value, the insurer will reduce reimbursement by the percentage by which the insured value of the item is less than the market value.

This scaling down applies only if the insured value is less than 80% of the market value of the item (6.1). It applies separately to each item of equipment (6.2).

It does **not** apply:
- to freight charges and labour costs (6.3)
- if the insured value is an agreed value (6.4)
